pairs: Or will a talkative man be justified?
Will men be silent only for you?
And when you have mocked others,
et mundus sum in conspectu tuo.
and I am clean in your sight.”
Yet I wish that God would speak with you,
and would open his lips to you,
so that he might reveal to you the secrets of wisdom,
et quod multiplex esset lex ejus:
and how intricate his law is,
et intelligeres quod multo minora exigaris ab eo quam meretur iniquitas tua!
and that you would understand how much less he requires of you than your iniquity deserves.
et usque ad perfectum Omnipotentem reperies?
will you comprehend the footsteps of God and reach all the way to the perfection of the Almighty?
His measure is longer than the earth
For he knows the vanity of men,
A vain man is lifted up in arrogance,
et tamquam pullum onagri se liberum natum putat.
and he thinks that he is born free like a wild ass’s colt.
But you have fortified your heart
et expandisti ad eum manus tuas.
and extended your hands to him.
Si iniquitatem quæ est in manu tua abstuleris a te,
If you would send away from you the iniquity that is in your hand,
et non manserit in tabernaculo tuo injustitia,
and not let injustice remain in your tabernacle,
tunc levare poteris faciem tuam absque macula;
then you would be able to lift up your face without blemish,
et quasi aquarum quæ præterierunt recordaberis.
or would remember only like waters that have passed by.
Et quasi meridianus fulgor consurget tibi ad vesperam;
And brightness, like that of midday, will rise upon you until evening,
and when you would think yourself consumed,
you will rise up like the morning star.
And, when hope has been set before you,
when buried, you will sleep secure.
et non erit qui te exterreat;
and there will be nothing to make you afraid,
and many will make requests before your face.
But the eyes of the impious will fade away,
and the path to escape will perish before them,
for the abomination of the soul is their hope.
